title: Ice gets stuck under blades
text: Ice gets stuck under blades. Large chunks of ice get stuck under blades. I had to keep removing pitcher to free up trapped ice with butter knife

product_metadata.title: BLACK+DECKER Countertop Blender with 5-Cup Glass Jar, 10-Speed Settings, Black, BL2010BG
features: 10 Speed Settings with Pulse - Find the right consistency for everything you make with a range of blending speeds
5-Cup Glass Jar - Easy to handle with a PerfectPour spout that eliminates drips and spills
Dishwasher-Safe Parts - Every removable part is safe to clean in the dishwasher, further simplifying the juice-making process
550 Watts of Blending Power! - The blender reaches 550 watts of power at peak performance*, and 350 watts of power for continuous use
description: The BLACK+DECKER 10-Speed Blender is a kitchen classic. With 10 speeds and a pulse control, operation is simple and efficient. The durable glass 5-cup (40-oz.) jar is easy to pour from and holds several servings of your favorite soups, smoothies, frozen mixers, and more! Plus, cleanup is a breeze thanks to the dishwasher-safe removable parts. *Peak performance refers to the maximum power recorded for 100ms during blending
